LanguageData.LP_Deity_Mystra.label: Mystra
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Mystra.description: Mystra, goddess of magic, guardian of the Weave. Wizards and clerics both enjoy her grace; she despises those who abuse magic, and the arcane demigods who tear the Weave.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Kelemvor.label: Kelemvor
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Kelemvor.description: Kelemvor, god of death, the just judge of the dead. He gives the dead rest and hates liches and necromantic constructs that flee death: a lich in the colony, lich revivals, troll revivals and soul draining all anger him.
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Shar.label: Shar
LanguageData.LP_Deity_Shar.description: Shar, goddess of darkness and loss, the Lady of the Night. Her followers pray in the dark and draw strength from loss; she is the sworn enemy of Mystra and Lathander.
